notes:
What you worked out by the end of trial 4:
  [1] Ripe beats unripe only on quiet patches; on contested patches eat what is there and move on.
  [2] Never take the last 1-2 apples of a patch: leave 3+ seeders so cells regrow; a bared patch never comes back.
  [3] All agents together bare every known patch by ~t90; early exploration to map patches + cycling several patches beats stripping one.
  [4] Purple ripes/over-ripes were my best earners; green ripes decent; unripes barely pay — prioritise ripe/over-ripe apples.
